description: Searches Wisdom Web’s library of public-domain quotes, each checked against its source text (Seneca, Lao Tzu, Emerson, Shakespeare, Proverbs and others). Returns up to 5 lines with author, book and source. Use plain words: "patience", "grief", "starting over", or an author’s name.

query.description: Words to search for, or an author. 2 to 200 characters.

topic.description: Optional Wisdom Web topic to stay within, such as "letting_go", "discipline" or "Stoicism".

name: search_quotes
title: Search verified quotes
